summary: Iter 13 validated two features: (1) Class-lock + Quiz-password enforcement on tugas/quiz endpoints — super_admin bypasses, non-unlocked non-super users have their class's items hidden from /api/assignments & /api/quizzes, /api/submissions/status returns 423, /api/quizzes/attempt returns 423 when quiz pw not unlocked. Guru CANNOT change class password (PATCH /api/classes/{id} -> 403). Quiz password lifecycle (create, patch to change, patch remove_password) all work; changing pw resets unlocked_quizzes for all students; siswa never receives 'answer' field or 'password_hash'; locked quiz returns questions=[] and question_count intact. (2) Weekly kas endpoint — Monday-Sunday WIB week range verified, siswa/guru -> 403, ketua_kelas (after unlock) + super_admin -> 200. Paying a student via POST /api/classes/{cid}/kas with student_id moves them from unpaid to paid. UI: guru.demo created a quiz with password (quiz-title-input, quiz-password-field, save-quiz-button) in XI IPA 1; siswa.demo saw quiz-lock-{id} badge + take-quiz button, opened quiz-unlock-modal, wrong pw got 400, correct pw opened quiz. Ketua kelas sees weekly-kas-card w/ summary 0/2, weekly-kas-amount, weekly-kas-unpaid-list, 2 weekly-pay-{id} buttons; kas-student-select enabled by default (masuk). Siswa does NOT see weekly-kas-card (count=0). Super admin DOES see weekly-kas-card but 0 pay buttons (read-only). Backend pytest: 12/12 PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~2320 lines; past-iter threshold flag still applies — consider splitting classes/quizzes/kas routers.
ClassKas.jsx exportXlsx still misses URL.revokeObjectURL (carried over from iter12).
quiz_out() mutates incoming dict (pops password_hash/answer) which is fine for find_one results but could be surprising if someone passes a cached object. Low priority.
weekly_kas_status computes week in server local WIB offset correctly; relies on uang_kas.created_at being ISO UTC with offset — current now_iso() consistency assumed.
